body.en: Your quota alerts now trigger earlier, and a single reading never sends two consecutive duplicate notifications. Starting with Codex 0.153.0, Plus and Team users are warned once less than half of the five-hour window remains. However, `usage` previously waited until 90% before alerting, meaning the monitored tool warned earlier than the monitor itself. The default threshold is now consistently set to `[50.0, 90.0]` across macOS and Windows, while remaining customizable via `quota_notification_thresholds`. A single reading can cross both thresholds at once, such as when the app launches with quota already at 95% or during a single large usage jump. In this situation, only the highest crossed threshold sends a notification while the rest are latched as notified, ensuring one observation never generates two duplicate alerts. ⟦A river warning system broadcasts once at half and once at ninety percent water levels; if a torrential storm pushes water past ninety percent instantly, only the most urgent red alert sounds without replaying lower-level warnings.⟧

items.original: **Quota warnings now fire at 50% as well as 90%, and one reading sends at most one notification.** Codex 0.153.0 began warning Plus and Team users once a five-hour window is less than half remaining; usage waited until 90%, so the tool it monitors warned earlier than the monitor did. The default is now `[50.0, 90.0]` on macOS and Windows alike, still overridable through `quota_notification_thresholds`. Because a single reading can cross both thresholds at once — the app launching when quota is already at 95%, or a single large jump — only the highest crossed threshold sends a notification and the rest are latched, so one observation never produces two alerts saying the same thing.

title.zh-TW: GitHub API 流量支援自訂閘道，身分驗證與網址維持直連
title.en: GitHub API Traffic Supports Custom Gateways, While Authentication and URLs Remain Direct

body.zh-TW:
企業若需要稽核或集中管控網路流量，現在可以透過個別主機的 `api_host` 設定，將 GitHub API 請求導向自訂閘道（gateway，把流量轉去另一個位址再送出的中繼點）。這項改動只會轉發 API 呼叫，登入身分驗證、Git 遠端儲存庫操作與瀏覽器開啟網址仍會直接連線至原始主機。此功能目前仍處於實驗階段，且不是安全邊界，部分請求可能依然會送往原始主機。

```
# 設定將 github.com 的 API 流量轉發至自訂閘道
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# 查詢特定主機目前設定的 API 閘道位址
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦這就像公司設立的公務收發室，員工採購與查詢資料等業務公文統一由專屬窗口轉交處理，但員工出勤打卡、私人包裹寄送與親自拜訪仍直接走大樓正門。⟧
body.en:
Organizations that need to audit or centrally manage network traffic can now route GitHub API requests to a custom gateway via the per-host `api_host` setting. This change only forwards API calls; login authentication, Git remote repository operations, and browser-opened URLs still connect directly to the original host. This feature is currently experimental and is not a security boundary, so some requests may still reach the original host.

```
# Set up forwarding API traffic for github.com to a custom gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Query the currently configured API gateway address for a specific host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦This is like a company mailroom for official business, where business documents such as procurement requests and data inquiries are routed through a dedicated counter, while employee clock-ins, personal parcel deliveries, and in-person visits still go directly through the building's main entrance.⟧

items.original:
## Experimental: Route GitHub API traffic through a custom host

Organizations can now route a GitHub host's API traffic through a gateway using the new per-host `api_host` configuration:

```shell
# Route API traffic for github.com through a gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Read the configured API host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

The original host remains in use for authentication, Git remotes, and browser URLs.

> [!NOTE]
> `api_host` is experimental and is not a security boundary. Requests may still reach the original host.

title.zh-TW: 在命令列直接把截圖和影片附進 issue 與 PR
title.en: Attach screenshots and videos to issues and PRs from the command line

body.zh-TW:
⟦你把沖洗好的照片一張張貼進日誌本，寫到哪一頁就貼在哪一頁；頁面上原本寫著「照片放這裡」的位置，照片會直接蓋上去，其他頁則往後補貼。⟧回報問題時想附一張截圖，以前得先開網頁上傳。現在 `gh` 多了 `--attach`，直接把本機的圖片和影片傳上去，接進 issue、pull request 或留言的內文。

```shell
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

內文若已經寫到那個本機路徑，`gh` 會把它換成上傳後的網址；沒寫到就補在最後。同一次指令要附多個檔案，就重複寫幾次這個旗標。這功能在 GitHub.com 與 GitHub Enterprise Cloud 上都能用。
body.en:
⟦You paste developed photos into a logbook page by page: where a page already says "photo goes here", the print covers that spot; elsewhere it goes on at the end.⟧ Reporting a bug with a screenshot used to mean opening the web page to upload it first. `gh` now has `--attach`, which uploads local images and videos and puts them into the body of an issue, a pull request, or a comment.

```shell
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

If the body already references that local path, `gh` swaps in the uploaded URL; otherwise the attachment is appended. Repeat the flag to attach several files in one invocation. Attachments work on GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud.

items.original:
## Attach images and videos to issues and pull requests

The repeatable `--attach` flag uploads local images and videos and adds them to issue, pull request, or comment bodies. If a body already references the local path, `gh` replaces it with the uploaded URL; otherwise it appends the attachment:

```shell
# Attach files when creating or editing an issue
gh issue create --attach './repro.png#The error state'
gh issue edit 123 --attach ./walkthrough.mp4

# Attach files when creating or editing a pull request
gh pr create --attach ./before.png
gh pr edit 456 --attach ./after.png

# Attach files to comments
gh issue comment 123 --attach ./repro.png
gh pr comment 456 --attach ./result.mp4
```

Repeat the flag to attach multiple files in a single invocation. Attachments are available on GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud.

For more information see https://gh.io/gh-attach and https://github.blog/changelog/2026-09-01-github-cli-media-in-issues-pull-requests-and-comments/

title.zh-TW: `gh issue develop` 能另開工作目錄，手上的東西不用收
title.en: `gh issue develop` can check the branch out in a separate worktree

body.zh-TW:
手邊的改動改到一半，issue 那頭又要你開一條新分支——以前得先收拾現場才能切過去。現在 `gh issue develop` 可以幫 issue 建好連動的分支，並且把它簽出到一個新的 Git worktree（工作樹，讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能），你目前這份工作目錄原封不動。

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦工地要趕另一項工程時，不必把現場拆掉重排，而是在旁邊另闢一塊作業區，兩邊同時進行。⟧
body.en:
You are halfway through a change when an issue needs a fresh branch, and until now you had to tidy up before switching over. `gh issue develop` can now create the linked branch for an issue and check it out in a new Git worktree, a second working copy of the same project that stands on its own, leaving your current working copy untouched.

```shell
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

⟦When a site has to start a second job, the crew does not tear down what is already laid out; they open a separate work area beside it and run both at once.⟧

items.original:
## Worktree support extended to `gh issue develop` 

`gh issue develop` can now create a linked branch and check it out in a new Git worktree, leaving your current working copy unchanged:

```shell
# Create a linked branch for an issue and check it out in a worktree
gh issue develop 123 --checkout --worktree /path/to/wt-feature
```

title.zh-TW: `gh pr checkout` 支援工作樹，切換 PR 不必動既有檔案
title.en: `gh pr checkout` adds `--worktree` to check out PRs into parallel copies

body.zh-TW: 正寫程式寫到一半，同事突然請你幫忙測試別人的 PR（pull request，請求將程式碼合併進專案的提案）。⟦像在圖書館查資料時直接影印一份副本帶到另一張桌子讀，原桌上攤開的筆記完全不用收拾。⟧這正是輸入 `gh pr checkout 123 --worktree` 的時刻。加上 `--worktree` 旗標後，系統會替該 PR 建立獨立的工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）。你能在新資料夾查看與測試變更，目前的檔案與分支留在原地，不必先把未完成的修改暫存收起。
body.en: While coding mid-task, a teammate asks you to test someone's PR (pull request). ⟦It is like photocopying a reference book in a library to read at another table without clearing your existing desk notes.⟧ That is the moment to run `gh pr checkout 123 --worktree`. Passing the `--worktree` flag creates an independent worktree, Git's feature for parallel working copies. You can inspect and test the changes in a separate folder while your current branch and files stay undisturbed.

title.zh-TW: issue 搜尋加入 `--search-type`，支援語意與混合查詢
title.en: `gh search issues` adds `--search-type` for semantic and hybrid search

body.zh-TW: 在專案裡搜尋 issue（議題，追蹤問題與建議的討論清單）時，以前只能比對一模一樣的關鍵字。⟦像找歌時忘記歌名，哼出大概的旋律能按感覺找；若還記得一小段歌詞，便把歌詞片段和旋律一起交給找歌的人。⟧`gh search issues` 現在新增了 `--search-type` 旗標，支援語意搜尋與混合搜尋兩種模式。當你記不清確切的錯誤文字時，輸入概念描述並加上 `--search-type semantic`，便能依背後涵義找出相近的討論；加上 `--search-type hybrid` 則會同時比對關鍵字與語意。
body.en: When searching for issues in a repository, you used to rely strictly on exact keyword matches. ⟦It is like finding a song from a rough hummed melody, then giving the song finder both that melody and a remembered lyric fragment when you have one.⟧ `gh search issues` now introduces the `--search-type` flag, supporting both semantic and hybrid search modes. If you cannot remember the exact error text, pass `--search-type semantic` with a natural concept description to find relevant issues by meaning; using `--search-type hybrid` combines traditional keyword matching with semantic understanding.

title.zh-TW: 呼叫擴充套件自動帶入 `GH_EXTENSION=1`，身分識別更明確
title.en: `gh` sets `GH_EXTENSION=1` when executing extensions

body.zh-TW: 撰寫或執行 GitHub CLI 擴充套件（extension，為 gh 新增自訂指令的附加工具）時，程式往往需要知道自己是怎麼被啟動的。⟦像員工佩戴公司發放的識別證進場，保全一眼就能確認他是從內部系統派來的，而不是自行闖入的外部訪客。⟧`gh` 現在在叫用任何擴充套件時，都會在環境變數（開程式之前預先塞給它的隱藏開關，一般使用者看不到）自動帶上 `GH_EXTENSION=1`。這讓擴充套件能藉由檢查該變數，確認自己正在被 `gh` 呼叫，並據此調整輸出格式或執行流程。
body.en: When writing or running a GitHub CLI extension (an add-on tool that introduces custom commands to gh), the program often needs to know how it was started. ⟦It is like an employee wearing a company badge into the building so security immediately recognizes they were dispatched by the internal system rather than entering unannounced.⟧ When `gh` invokes any extension, it now automatically sets the environment variable `GH_EXTENSION=1`. Extensions can check this variable to confirm they are running under `gh` and adjust their output formatting or behavior accordingly.

title.zh-TW: 修正 `RESTWithNext` 錯誤型態，恢復 `gh status` 與 attestation 重試
title.en: Fixed `RESTWithNext` error type to restore `gh status` and attestation retries

body.en: When `gh status` hits a retryable failure, the `RESTWithNext` error-type handling had prevented retries. That is fixed: both `gh status` and attestations (digital signatures that verify a software artifact's origin and build process) can retry again. ⟦It is like a filing desk returning a form with a faulty receipt to the processing queue instead of rejecting the whole submission.⟧

Its parser now strips extra surrounding whitespace so that whitespace is not treated as part of a scope name. ⟦It is like erasing stray spaces beside names on a roster so one person is not mistaken for another.⟧

Its output in that case is fixed, so the command emits the correct output in non-interactive environments. ⟦It is like a shipping form that skips the service-desk screen and enters an automated sorting line while still printing the correct machine-readable label.⟧

items.original: Fix project item-add output for non-TTY by @zwick in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14056

title.zh-TW: 七項 API 請求收攏至 `api.Client`，統一金鑰與發布通道

This covers deploy keys, ssh keys, gpg keys, autolinks, extensions, release creation, and release deletions. Routing these calls through a single client keeps network logic clean and consistent across the codebase.

The project now introduces a scheduled tech debt burndown skill for AI agents. Once configured with a schedule, the agent automatically triggers on a recurring interval to inspect the codebase and clean up technical debt. ⟦It is like putting a regular deep-cleaning schedule on the building calendar to clear out accumulated clutter from the storage room before it piles up.⟧ Standardizing and scheduling these cleanups helps teams keep the repository tidy and maintainable over time.

title.zh-TW: 不需要清理時不再要求功能偵測註解
title.en: Feature detection no longer requests cleanup comments when unneeded

body.zh-TW: 功能偵測（feature detection，先確認功能是否可用的做法）不需要清理時，現在不再要求清理註解。這條規則把是否需要清理當成是否提出註解要求的界線：有清理需要的地方可留下相應註解，沒有清理需要的地方則不因同一件事再被要求補註。⟦像工作單只在確有後續收尾工作時附上提醒；沒有待收尾的項目，就不多附一張提醒單。⟧改動的重點是刪除不必要的要求，讓註解要求和實際清理需要對齊。
body.en: When feature detection (checking whether a capability is available) needs no cleanup, it no longer requests a cleanup comment. Whether cleanup is needed now forms the boundary for asking for that comment: a corresponding comment can be left where cleanup is needed, but an item needing none is not asked for one. ⟦It is like attaching a reminder to a work order only when follow-up work really remains; an item with nothing to finish gets no extra reminder slip.⟧ The change removes an unneeded request so that the request for a comment matches the actual need for cleanup.

items.original: Don't ask for feature detection cleanup comments when not needed by @babakks in https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14139

title.zh-TW: 建置工具與相依套件升級，Dependabot 新增 aw-actions 群組
title.en: Build tools and dependencies upgraded; Dependabot gains an aw-actions group

body.zh-TW: Dependabot 設定新增 `aw-actions` 群組，並更新 `aw-actions`、`codeql-actions`、sigstore-go、gRPC、go-containerregistry、actions/attest、azure/login、goldmark、protobuf、testify、x/crypto、lipgloss 與壓縮函式庫。Go 依序升至 1.26.6、1.26.7，CI 的 golangci-lint 升至 v2.12.2；gh-aw workflows 升至 v0.85.4，gh-aw-actions 升至 v0.87.1 並重新編譯 agentic workflows。⟦像維修清單逐項更換零件，連自動補貨規則與已組裝的工作單也一併更新。⟧
body.en: Dependabot configuration now includes an `aw-actions` group, while `aw-actions`, `codeql-actions`, sigstore-go, gRPC, go-containerregistry, actions/attest, azure/login, goldmark, protobuf, testify, x/crypto, lipgloss, and a compression library were updated. Go moved through 1.26.6 to 1.26.7, CI's golangci-lint reached v2.12.2, gh-aw workflows reached v0.85.4, and gh-aw-actions reached v0.87.1 with agentic workflows recompiled. ⟦It is like replacing parts from a maintenance list while updating the automatic replenishment rule and already assembled work orders too.⟧
